title: Agentic AI | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Agentic AI. Category: Development. Duration: 12 months. Description: Agentic AI Engineer: a one-year program training students to build intelligent AI-powered applications and autonomous digital assistants, covering AI concepts, automation, AI agents, prompt engineering, and workflow development. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
